definitions.explanation: Describes something or someone that is endearingly attractive, charming, or lovable. One of the most commonly used adjectives in Japanese, especially when describing children, animals, or aesthetically pleasing items.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{犬|いぬ}→犬：00632_inu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧かわいい⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧。
examples.english: This dog is very cute, isn't it?

examples.japanese: かわいい⟦{服|ふく}→服：00695_fuku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}いました→買う：00489_kau⟧。
⟦{赤|あか}ちゃん→赤ちゃん：01282_akachan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧かわいい!
⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{女|おんな}の{子|こ}→女の子：02865_onnanoko⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧かわいい⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧。
examples.english: That girl is very cute, isn't she?

examples.japanese: ⟦{妹|いもうと}→妹：00573_imouto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧かわいい⟦{猫|ねこ}→猫：02237_neko⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}せて→見せる：01988_miseru⟧⟦くれました→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: My younger sister showed me a photo of a cute cat.

notes:
かわいい is an i-adjective meaning cute or adorable. It can be written as {可愛|かわい}い in kanji but hiragana is far more common.

FORMS:
- Adverbial: かわいく (e.g. かわいく⟦{着飾|きかざ}る→着飾る：15040_kikazaru⟧, to dress up cutely)
- Noun form: かわいさ (cuteness)

USAGE:
Extremely versatile — used for people (especially children), animals, objects, fashion, voices, and even actions. It is central to Japanese "kawaii culture," which values cuteness across fashion, entertainment, and daily life.
When used about one's own children, かわいい can also carry the nuance of "dear" or "beloved" rather than just physical cuteness.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦かわいらしい→可愛らしい：02341_kawairashii⟧: gives a softer, more admiring nuance ("charmingly cute")
- ⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧: beautiful (aesthetic beauty rather than cuteness)
- ⟦きれい→きれい：00717_kirei⟧: pretty, clean (more neutral/adult tone)
